datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Chad administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases (IPC scale) for different scenarios, with spatial boundaries and temporal coverage from February through October 2017.
